description: Source code for a class implementing a document loader node that uses Apify's website content crawler, integrating with langchain and custom utilities to fetch, process, and output web content data.

classes.name: ApifyWebsiteContentCrawler_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Implements a node for loading web content from Apify using various crawling options, with support for text splitting and metadata handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, performs web content loading via Apify, applies text splitting and metadata processing, and returns either documents or concatenated text.
